statusVocabulary.configured: Entrypoint/runner/task is named but no execution is proven.
statusVocabulary.blocked: A prerequisite, environment, credential, or decision is missing.
statusVocabulary.not-run: Ready or not yet attempted; no result claimed.
statusVocabulary.executed-passed: Actual command completed with exit 0 and captured evidence.
statusVocabulary.executed-failed: Actual command completed nonzero or assertions failed; evidence preserved.
statusVocabulary.excluded: Outside the authorized Task B scope; remains an explicit release hold.

verificationLevels.not-run: Placeholder: no execution and no level established.
verificationLevels.compiled: Compile/link task completed; framework/app is not execution.
verificationLevels.automated-logic-tested: Named tests executed with exact counts/results.
verificationLevels.native-executed: Native decoder/engine/helper actually executed; silent/null output labeled.
verificationLevels.packaged: Platform distributable produced and hashed; not installed/launched.
verificationLevels.runtime-smoke-tested: Packaged app started and performed named assertions on stated host/guest.
verificationLevels.installed: OS installer transaction completed and app launched in a clean environment.
verificationLevels.physical-device-tested: Exact hardware/route/audio behavior observed; emulator/simulator/null sink excluded.

evidenceRecordSchema.testLevel: one verification level plus detailed sublevel
evidenceRecordSchema.junitPaths: array of exact scoped XML paths
evidenceRecordSchema.retentionRoute: approved durable route identifier; empty until B-RET-01/B-RET-02
evidenceRecordSchema.retentionLocation: actual durable location of the retained package/log/XML/metadata set
evidenceRecordSchema.retainedAtUtc: ISO-8601 UTC when the actual final set was retained
evidenceRecordSchema.retentionManifestSha256: SHA-256 of the retained manifest, verified by independent readback

evidenceSchemaNote: runs is intentionally empty. Populate only from actual executions; never invent timestamps, SHAs, counts, or paths.
